title: Strong cosmic censorship for the spherically symmetric Einstein-Maxwell-charged-Klein-Gordon system with positive Lambda: stability of the Cauchy horizon and H^1 extensions

verification.evidence: Abstract: 'We investigate the interior of a dynamical black hole as described by the Einstein-Maxwell-charged-Klein-Gordon system ... In this context, we show the existence of C^0 spacetime extensions beyond CH^+. Moreover, if the scalar field decays at a sufficiently fast rate along H^+, we show that the renormalized Hawking mass remains bounded for a large set of initial data. ... In this no-mass-inflation scenario, which includes near-extremal solutions, we further prove that the spacetime can be extended across the Cauchy horizon with continuous metric, Christoffel symbols in L^2_loc and scalar field in H^1_loc. By generalizing the work of Costa-Girao-Natario-Silva to the case of a charged and massive scalar field, our results reveal a potential failure of the Christodoulou-Chrusciel version of the strong cosmic censorship under spherical symmetry.' Journal ref: Ann. Henri Poincare 26, 675-753 (2025); DOI 10.1007/s00023-024-01454-x.

notes: Second verified usage of the term 'Christodoulou-Chrusciel version' (after SRC-029). Extends the range of parameters where mass inflation is prevented up to the threshold suggested by Costa-Franzen and Hintz-Vasy.

title: Strong cosmic censorship in T^3-Gowdy spacetimes (OpenAlex abstract reconstruction)

verification.evidence: Reconstructed abstract (OpenAlex inverted index): '...it is then natural to make the strong cosmic censorship conjecture, which states that for generic initial data, the MGHD is inextendible. ... Here, we [consider] T^3-Gowdy spacetimes. In a previous paper, we introduced a set [of initial data] ... proved [it] is open ... C^1-topology. The solutions corresponding ... have the following properties. First, [they are C^2]-inextendible. Second, [for a] causal geodesic [with] time direction, it is either complete, or [a] curvature invariant, [the] Kretschmann scalar, is unbounded along [it] ... The purpose of the present paper [is to prove the set is] dense [in the] C^infinity-topology.'

title: Stability and instability of the Cauchy horizon for the spherically symmetric Einstein-Maxwell-scalar field equations (OpenAlex abstract reconstruction)

verification.evidence: Reconstructed abstract (OpenAlex inverted index): 'This paper considers a trapped characteristic initial value problem for the spherically symmetric Einstein-Maxwell-scalar field equations. For an open set of initial data whose closure contains in particular Reissner-Nordstrom data, the future boundary of the maximal domain of development is found to be a light-like surface along which the curvature blows up, and yet the metric can be continuously extended beyond it. This result is related to the strong cosmic censorship conjecture of Roger Penrose.'

notes: Machine-reconstructed abstract. Confirms the open-set statement and the C^0 extension; also adds a third attribution data point ('the strong cosmic censorship conjecture of Roger Penrose'), balancing the 'Christodoulou's C^0 formulation' usages in SRC-021/056/061.
